howToPlay: Place your signals strategically to control the map and create lanes for movement. Use the Super to dash between signals for offensive strikes or quick retreats. Manage your gadget charges to reposition signals or bypass obstacles to catch enemies off guard.
gears: Use DAMAGE and SPEED for increased combat effectiveness and better navigation. SHIELD and HEALTH are excellent choices for survivability while setting up your signals.
trait: This controller suits players who enjoy tactical planning and maneuvering through a network of pre-placed traps.
